analogy.rationale: The antibacterial agent is annotated to target DNMT1, so its transcriptional signature should most resemble DNA methyltransferase inhibitors; other antiinfective classes share the general antimicrobial context but act on unrelated targets and should produce weak or dissimilar responses in these human cell lines.
